[.walkthrough]
.Duplicate a button, delete it, and copy a field
. Select a component and open its menu: click *⋮* in its badge, or right-click the component. *Duplicate* adds a [.walkthrough-look]#copy# right after it.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/01-duplicate.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/01-duplicate.jpg"]
. *Delete* removes the selected component, here the copy, from the view and from [filename]#ContactView.java#.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/02-delete.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/02-delete.jpg"]
. *Copy* puts the selected component on the clipboard, here the Phone field.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/03-copy.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/03-copy.jpg"]
. Select a component and choose *Paste*. The [.walkthrough-look]#copy# goes after it, here at the end of the form.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/04-paste.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/copy-and-paste/04-paste.jpg"]
